In addition, even at a fixed common index, the two exceedance point measures have order-\(k_n\) overlap, so a joint information form cannot in general be obtained by summing the two marginal intensity informations \(I_{rs}=\sum_{a=1}^2\int\dot\ell_{a,r}\dot\ell_{a,s}\,dM_{\vartheta_0}^{(a)}\).  A valid formulation must at least add a root-\(k_n\) common-tail-index coordinate and a joint overlap intensity, or an equivalent paired marked point process, before bias drifts and a uniform likelihood remainder can be defined.

For every \(n\), define the sample map
\[
 C_n^*(z_1,\ldots,z_n)=\mathcal A_{\mathrm{dir}}
 \qquad\text{for every }(z_1,\ldots,z_n)\in(\mathbb R_+^2)^n,
\]
and, for every \(c\in\mathcal C\), define \(C_n^{*,(c)}=\mathcal A_{\mathrm{dir}}\).  Then, for every \(\eta\in(0,1/2)\),
\[
 (C_n^*)\in\mathcal H_\eta(\Theta_{\mathrm{CTC}}(B)),
 \qquad
 (C_n^{*,(c)})\in\mathcal H_\eta(\Theta_{\mathrm{CTC}}(B^{(c)}))
 \quad(c\in\mathcal C).
\]
Their coverage probability is exactly one for every member of the respective model class, including every member with \(\Delta_n=0\).  They are equivariant under exchanging the two variable labels, and
\[
 c\leq c'\quad\Longrightarrow\quad
 C_n^{*,(c)}=C_n^{*,(c')}=\mathcal A_{\mathrm{dir}}.
\]
For every \(\kappa\in[0,\infty]\) and compact \(K\subset\mathcal L_\kappa\) such that \(K_n(K,\kappa;B)\) is nonempty for all sufficiently large \(n\), the resulting finite-grid oracle ambiguity statement is the exact, grid-independent value
\[
 \sup_{\theta_n\in K_n(K,\kappa;B)}
 P_{\theta,n}^{\otimes n}\{C_n^*=\mathcal A_{\mathrm{dir}}\}=1
\]
for all sufficiently large \(n\), irrespective of \(\mathcal G_n\), \(B_n(k)\), \(s_{\mathrm{CTC},n}(k)\), and \(s_{\mathrm{idx},n}(k)\).  Thus the frozen premises give an exact partial answer to the adaptive-set question, but they do not give the requested vanishing-ambiguity conclusion when the reported separations diverge.

defs.def:honest-direction-class: \[\mathcal H_\eta(\Theta_{\mathrm{CTC}}(B))=\left\{(C_n)_{n\geq1}: C_n\in\{\{\mathsf{forward}\},\{\mathsf{reverse}\},\mathcal A_{\mathrm{dir}}\},\ C_n\text{ is }\mathcal T_n\text{-measurable},\ \liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{\theta\in\Theta_{\mathrm{CTC}}(B)}P_{\theta,n}^{\otimes n}\{o(\theta_n)\in C_n\}\geq1-\eta\right\}.\]
defs.def:local-array-set: \(K_n(K,\kappa;B)=\{\theta_n: (\theta_m)_{m\geq1}\in\Theta_{\mathrm{CTC}}(B),\ \kappa_m\to\kappa,\ (\lambda_n,h_n,b_{1,n},b_{2,n})\in K\}\) for a named compact \(K\subset\mathcal L_\kappa\).
defs.def:tail-rank-experiment: The experiment \(\{(\mathcal T_n,P_{\theta,n}^{\otimes n}|_{\mathcal T_n}):\theta\in\Theta_{\mathrm{CTC}}(B)\}\), where \(\mathcal T_n\) contains \(N_n^{(1)}\), \(N_n^{(2)}\), and both marginal upper-order-statistic arrays.

assumptions.ass:iid-triangular-sampling: For every \(n\) and structural tuple \(\theta_n\), the observations \(Z_{1,n},\ldots,Z_{n,n}\) are independent with common law \(P_{\theta,n}\).
assumptions.ass:continuous-margins: The distribution functions \(F_{1,n}\) and \(F_{2,n}\) are continuous.
assumptions.ass:uniform-second-order-variation: For \(j\in\{1,2\}\), either \(A_{j,n}\equiv0\) and \(U_{j,n}(sx)/U_{j,n}(s)=x^{1/\alpha_{j,n}}\), or, uniformly for \(x\) in compact subsets of \((0,\infty)\), \[\frac{U_{j,n}(sx)/U_{j,n}(s)-x^{1/\alpha_{j,n}}}{A_{j,n}(s)}\to x^{1/\alpha_0}\frac{x^{\rho_j}-1}{\rho_j}\] as \(s\to\infty\), uniformly over the triangular array.
assumptions.ass:tail-constant-balance: The threshold-normalized tail constants satisfy \(c_{1,n}/c_{2,n}\to c_0\in(0,\infty)\).
assumptions.ass:bounded-bias-coordinates: The sequence \((b_{1,n},b_{2,n})\) is bounded in \(\mathbb R^2\).
